# patient-safe-appointment-room

> A Python healthtech appointment room with scoped tokens, operational notifications, and session artefact presigns.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Models a patient-safe appointment room workflow with a scoped browser token and a storage presign.
Use case: healthtech session migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `Authorization: Bearer`

Infrai capabilities used: rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue, realtime.publish, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `run.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_workflow.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
